summary: Iteration 40: Complete testing of solicitações de entrada em assessorias feature. All 15 backend tests passed (1 expected failure due to business logic). Frontend testing verified: login as dono_assessoria, 'Minha Assessoria' menu in header, DonoAssessoriaDashboard with 'Solicitações' tab showing badge counter, approve and reject flows working with toast notifications.

minor.issue: Returns 404 if assessoria has no users with role='atleta'. This prevents DonoAssessoriaDashboard from loading if the team only has dono_assessoria users
minor.workaround: Ensure at least one role='atleta' user is in the team

action_items: Consider modifying GET /api/liga-assessorias/assessoria/{nome} to include dono_assessoria role users in the atletas query, so the dashboard loads even without role=atleta users
critical_code_review_comments: Backend solicitações endpoints are well implemented with proper authorization checks
DonoAssessoriaDashboard.jsx correctly fetches solicitações and displays badge counter (lines 128-138, 299-343)
Approve/Reject handlers update database and show toast notifications correctly (lines 140-173)
Empty state properly displayed when no pending requests (lines 746-756)
seed_data_creation: Created test atleta 'Teste Atleta Speed' for Speed Team to enable dashboard loading. Created test solicitações for testing approve/reject flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Solicitações feature fully functional. Backend endpoints: GET /api/assessorias/solicitacoes-pendentes (returns pending requests), POST /api/assessorias/aprovar-solicitacao/{id} (approves and adds athlete to team), POST /api/assessorias/reprovar-solicitacao/{id} (rejects request). Frontend: DonoAssessoriaDashboard has 'Solicitações' tab in sidebar with animated badge showing pending count. Both approve and reject flows show toast notifications and update the list.

GET_solicitacoes_pendentes.details: Returns list of pending requests with total_pendentes count. Requires dono_assessoria, admin or super_admin role.

POST_aprovar_solicitacao.details: Approves request, updates athlete's equipe to assessoria_nome, shows success toast.

POST_reprovar_solicitacao.details: Rejects request with optional motivo, shows 'Solicitação reprovada' toast.

POST_solicitar_entrada.details: Allows athlete without team to request entry. Returns 400 if already in a team.

frontend_solicitacoes_tab.details: Shows 'Solicitações' with animated badge showing pending count. Badge hidden when count is 0.

frontend_solicitacoes_list.details: Displays pending requests with avatar, name, location, date, message, and Aprovar/Reprovar/Ver Perfil buttons.

frontend_approve_flow.details: Clicking Aprovar shows toast '{name} foi adicionado(a) à assessoria!', updates list.

frontend_reject_flow.details: Clicking Reprovar shows toast 'Solicitação reprovada', removes request from list.

endpoints_tested.POST /api/auth/login (dono): 200 OK - Returns token and user with role=dono_assessoria
endpoints_tested.POST /api/assessorias/aprovar-solicitaca: 200 OK for valid, 404 for invalid ID, 401/403 without auth
endpoints_tested.POST /api/assessorias/reprovar-solicitac: 200 OK for valid, 404 for invalid ID, 401/403 without auth
endpoints_tested.GET /api/liga-assessorias/assessoria/{no: 200 OK if team has atletas, 404 if team only has dono_assessoria users
